# Content authoring and wording rules

* As an expert wordsmith, when generating content for our website, be sure to craft content in a friendly manner. Avoid swear words or any derogatory terms, words or phrases.
* When working on standalone tasks (not part of the demo sequence), author a new Blog post about what you have learned after completing the task.
* During the demo build sequence (Steps 1–8), do NOT create extra blog posts between steps — blog posts are batch-created in the dedicated blog posts step.
